description: 16 CEDARWOOD PLANKS FOR THE WARDROBE – NATURAL MOTH PROTECTION AND WARDROBE FRAGRANCE BY INOVIDA: The American cedar is a majestic evergreen tree known for its uniquely aromatic scent. The natural oils release a soothing, woody fragrance that promotes a calm and relaxing atmosphere. Clothes moths naturally avoid the scent of cedarwood essential oil as they find it unpleasant. Our 100% natural and untreated cedarwood gently repels textile moths from the wardrobe and effectively helps to prevent moth infestation. The pleasantly scented essential oil in the cedarwood rings also provides a fresh odour to the wardrobe, drawer or cupboard. EASY TO USE: Place the cedar wood planks in your shoe cabinet, nightstand, wardrobe or drawer. For the best protection and to maintain the fresh scent, lightly sand the wood every 2 – 3 months with the included sandpaper. LONG-LASTING FRAGRANCE: Cedar has a long-lasting, aromatic, spicy and sweet woody scent. Our wooden planks are very durable. They can be easily roughened with fine sandpaper to renew the fresh scent of the natural essential oils as often as required. The sandpaper is also included in the delivery.
